title: 79: rs/README.md describes the packaged crate's contents the way #70a packages it (REQ-release-3): library sources, tests/*.rs, the vectors/ copies, README and license; the example and pqcross stay in the checkout; 0.6.0 predates this
description: 79: rs/README.md describes the packaged crate's contents the way #70a packages it (REQ-release-3): library sources, tests/*.rs, the vectors/ copies, README and license; the example and pqcross stay in the checkout; 0.6.0 predates this
no_spec_change_rationale: Docs-only correction: rs/README.md is brought in line with REQ-release-3 as already approved and implemented by #70a; no requirement, contract or code changes
acceptance_criteria: rs/README.md's install section says the packaged crate contains the library sources, tests/*.rs, the vectors/ copies those tests read, the README and the license, so cargo test runs from the package; the export_envelopes example and the pqcross binary stay in the repository; it notes that the 0.6.0 crates.io release predates this. The sentence agrees with the README's Compatibility evidence section and with cargo package --list (src/*.rs, tests/*.rs, vectors/*.json, README.md, LICENSE; no src/bin or examples). No code, packaging, spec or requirement changes.
